tutorial.welcome.en: Welcome, young leader. I am Sensei Hoshi. Our clan has found a hidden valley in the mountains. Let's build a village no rival can find.
tutorial.welcome.text: Selamat datang, pemimpin muda. Aku Sensei Hoshi. Klan kita menemukan lembah tersembunyi di pegunungan. Ayo bangun desa yang tak bisa ditemukan saingan mana pun.

tutorial.mint.collect.en: Your Coin Mint is striking Coins. When a coin floats over it, tap it, then Collect.
tutorial.mint.collect.text: Pencetak Koin-mu sedang mencetak Koin. Saat koin melayang di atasnya, ketuk, lalu Kumpulkan.

tutorial.mint.build.en: A clan runs on Coins. Tap Build and place a Coin Mint.
tutorial.mint.build.text: Klan bergantung pada Koin. Ketuk Bangun dan pasang Pencetak Koin.

tutorial.keep.en: Now strengthen the Clan Keep: tap the castle, then Upgrade.
tutorial.keep.text: Sekarang perkuat Benteng Klan: ketuk kastelnya, lalu Tingkatkan.

tutorial.finishKeep.wait.en: Upgrades take time. The Keep is ready in {time}: come back then, or tap Finish now to use a little Jade.
tutorial.finishKeep.wait.text: Peningkatan butuh waktu. Benteng siap dalam {time}: kembali nanti, atau ketuk Selesaikan sekarang dengan sedikit Giok.

tutorial.finishKeep.done.en: The Keep is ready. Well done!

tutorial.army.tower.en: Rival clans will raid us. Build a Kunai Tower next to the Keep (Build, then the Defense tab): it shoots any raider in range.
tutorial.army.tower.text: Klan saingan akan menyerbu kita. Bangun Menara Kunai di dekat Benteng (Bangun, lalu tab Pertahanan): menara ini menembak penyerbu dalam jangkauan.

tutorial.army.all.en: Build a Training Dojo, a Squad Courtyard and a Kunai Tower next to the Keep (Build: the Army tab, then the Defense tab).
tutorial.army.all.text: Bangun Dojo Latihan, Halaman Pasukan, dan Menara Kunai di dekat Benteng (Bangun: tab Pasukan, lalu tab Pertahanan).

tutorial.train.en: Open the Army panel and train some Shinobi: fast blades that strike the nearest building.
tutorial.train.text: Buka panel Pasukan dan latih beberapa Shinobi: petarung cepat yang menyerang bangunan terdekat.

tutorial.finishTrain.wait.en: Training takes time too: your warriors are ready in {time}. Wait, or tap Finish training to use a little Jade.
tutorial.finishTrain.wait.text: Latihan juga butuh waktu: prajuritmu siap dalam {time}. Tunggu, atau ketuk Selesaikan latihan dengan sedikit Giok.

tutorial.raid.en: Your first raid. Tap Attack, look over the target, then Attack! On the battlefield I will show you one thing at a time: send your Shinobi in through a glowing point, then smoke them as they reach a tower: warriors inside the smoke can only be shot from close up.
tutorial.raid.text: Serbuan pertamamu. Ketuk Serang, periksa sasarannya, lalu Serang! Di medan perang aku akan menunjukkan satu hal setiap kali: kirim Shinobi-mu lewat titik yang bercahaya, lalu selubungi mereka dengan asap saat mendekati menara: prajurit di dalam asap hanya bisa ditembak dari jarak dekat.

tutorial.end.en: Well fought. Upgrade the Training Dojo to unlock Saboteurs: they jam a defense for a few seconds. Jam first, then strike, and smoke your warriors where the fire is heaviest. Collect, upgrade, raid, and join an Alliance.
tutorial.end.text: Pertarungan yang hebat. Tingkatkan Dojo Latihan untuk membuka Penyabot: mereka melumpuhkan satu pertahanan selama beberapa detik. Lumpuhkan dulu, lalu serang, dan beri asap pada prajuritmu di tempat tembakan paling deras. Kumpulkan, tingkatkan, serbu, dan bergabunglah dengan Aliansi.

objective.keep.en: Upgrade your Clan Keep to Lv {level}

objective.save.en: {need} more for {building} Lv {level}: collect or raid
objective.save.text: Kurang {need} untuk {building} Lv {level}: kumpulkan atau menyerbu

battle.scoutSummary.en: {points, plural, one {# point} other {# points}} · {defenses, plural, one {# defense} other {# defenses}}
battle.scoutSummary.text: {points, plural, other {# titik}} · {defenses, plural, other {# pertahanan}}

battle.offscreen.en: Infiltration point {label}, {left} space left, is off screen: show it
battle.offscreen.text: Titik infiltrasi {label}, sisa ruang {left}, ada di luar layar: tampilkan

calendar.about.en: One reward a day, the same for everyone, never random and never sold. Miss a day and nothing is lost: the next claim is the next day on the list. Day 28 gives a Keep look.
calendar.about.text: Satu hadiah sehari, sama untuk semua orang, tidak pernah acak dan tidak pernah dijual. Terlewat sehari pun tidak ada yang hilang: klaim berikutnya adalah hari berikutnya di daftar. Hari ke-28 memberi tampilan Benteng.

calendar.gotLook.en: A new Keep look is yours: Store → Looks.
calendar.gotLook.text: Tampilan Benteng baru jadi milikmu: Toko → Tampilan.

daily.missed.en: {n, plural, one {You missed # day without a skip, so your streak moved back # step.} other {You missed # days without a skip, so your streak moved back # steps.}}
daily.missed.text: {n, plural, other {Kamu melewatkan # hari tanpa lompatan, jadi rentetanmu mundur # langkah.}}

offers.noAge.en: Special offers appear only once you have told us your age (Settings → Account → Spending → Set age group).
offers.noAge.text: Penawaran khusus baru muncul setelah kamu memberi tahu usiamu (Pengaturan → Akun → Pengeluaran → Atur kelompok usia).

offers.minor.en: Special offers do not pop up for players under 18. Everything in the Jade tab stays available within your spending limit.
offers.minor.text: Penawaran khusus tidak muncul untuk pemain di bawah 18 tahun. Semua yang ada di tab Giok tetap tersedia dalam batas pengeluaranmu.

offers.none.text: Belum ada penawaran khusus saat ini.

army.finishedN.en: {n, plural, one {# finished warrior} other {# finished warriors}}

settings.languageNote.en: The game follows your device language when it can. More languages arrive as their translations are finished.
settings.languageNote.text: Game mengikuti bahasa perangkatmu jika bisa. Bahasa lain akan hadir setelah terjemahannya selesai.

research.lanesFree.en: {n, plural, one {# research lane free.} other {# research lanes free.}}

pass.value.text: ≈ nilai {jade} Giok · {tiers}/{total} tingkat dapat dicapai · {days, plural, other {sisa # hari}}

Anything already spent shows as a negative balance that your income pays back.}}
purchase.refunded.text: {n, plural, =1 {Toko mengembalikan dana sebuah pembelian, jadi isinya diambil kembali. Apa pun yang sudah terpakai tampil sebagai saldo negatif yang dilunasi dari pendapatanmu.} other {Toko mengembalikan dana # pembelian, jadi isinya diambil kembali. Apa pun yang sudah terpakai tampil sebagai saldo negatif yang dilunasi dari pendapatanmu.}}

purchase.reinstated.en: {n, plural, one {A refund was reversed: your purchase is back.} other {# refunds were reversed: your purchases are back.}}
purchase.reinstated.text: {n, plural, =1 {Pengembalian dana dibatalkan: pembelianmu kembali.} other {# pengembalian dana dibatalkan: pembelianmu kembali.}}

store.withdrawalStipend.en: Delivery starts at once: the first payment can be claimed now and one more each day; by buying you agree that you lose the right to cancel, as the law allows for digital content.
store.withdrawalStipend.text: Pengiriman langsung dimulai: pembayaran pertama bisa diklaim sekarang dan satu lagi setiap hari; dengan membeli, kamu setuju kehilangan hak pembatalan, sebagaimana diizinkan hukum untuk konten digital.

store.error.cancelled.text: Pembelian dibatalkan. Tidak ada biaya yang ditagih.

store.error.unavailable.en: Purchases are not available right now. Try again later.
store.error.unavailable.text: Pembelian sedang tidak tersedia. Coba lagi nanti.

store.error.failed.en: The purchase did not go through. If you were charged, it is delivered as soon as the store confirms it.
store.error.failed.text: Pembelian tidak berhasil. Jika kamu sudah ditagih, isinya dikirim begitu toko mengonfirmasinya.

raid.rejected.no_warriors.en: No warriors fought, so it counts as practice.
raid.rejected.no_warriors.text: Tidak ada prajurit yang bertarung, jadi dihitung sebagai latihan.

temper.intro.en: Shape every {building} at once. Reach shoots farther but hits softer and goes for back-line warriors first; Blast hits groups but fires slower; Watch makes the Sky Bow Tower, the Bitter Smoke Brazier and traps stronger. Raiders see the shape when they scout.
temper.intro.text: Bentuk setiap {building} sekaligus. Jangkauan menembak lebih jauh tetapi lebih lemah dan mengincar prajurit barisan belakang lebih dulu; Ledakan mengenai kelompok tetapi menembak lebih lambat; Siaga memperkuat Menara Busur Langit, Anglo Asap Pahit, dan jebakan. Penyerbu melihat bentuknya saat mengintai.

temper.left.en: {n, plural, one {# point left} other {# points left}}

temper.done.en: Tempered: every {building} has its new shape.
temper.done.text: Selesai ditempa: setiap {building} punya bentuk barunya.

temper.watchSupport.en: Watch also weakens the raiders' healing, revives, toughness and shield cover across the whole base.
temper.watchSupport.text: Siaga juga melemahkan penyembuhan, kebangkitan, ketangguhan, dan perlindungan perisai penyerbu di seluruh desa.

stake.help.en: Declare a result before you attack: reach it and carry more loot home, miss it and carry none.
stake.help.text: Nyatakan hasil sebelum menyerang: capai dan bawa pulang lebih banyak jarahan, gagal dan tidak membawa apa-apa.

stake.missed.en: Stake missed: you declared {stars}★, so no loot came home.
stake.missed.text: Taruhan gagal: kamu menyatakan {stars}★, jadi tidak ada jarahan yang dibawa pulang.

carry.diversity.en: Your squad carried {pct} of the loot. Squads of more roles carry more.
carry.diversity.text: Regumu membawa {pct} jarahan. Regu dengan lebih banyak peran membawa lebih banyak.

raid.rejected.conflict.en: The opponent changed at the same moment.
raid.rejected.conflict.text: Lawan berubah pada saat yang sama.

raid.rejected.version_mismatch.en: This version of the game is too old.

ledger.refunded.text: Pembelian yang dananya dikembalikan diambil kembali

res.debt.en: You owe {amount} {resource} from a refunded purchase. It is paid back from your future income; nothing else is taken.
res.debt.text: Kamu berutang {amount} {resource} dari pembelian yang dananya dikembalikan. Utang ini dilunasi dari pendapatanmu nanti; tidak ada lagi yang diambil.

sync.refused.en: {n, plural, one {The server refused # action because your village had changed, for example on another device. The village on the server is the one kept.} other {The server refused # actions because your village had changed, for example on another device. The village on the server is the one kept.}}
sync.refused.text: {n, plural, other {Server menolak # tindakan karena desamu sudah berubah, misalnya di perangkat lain. Desa yang di server yang disimpan.}}

news.offline.en: Messages from the game's operators arrive when you play online.
news.offline.text: Pesan dari pengelola game akan tiba saat kamu bermain online.

account.signOutDevice.note.en: Finished playing on this phone or browser? Sign it out. Your online account stays for your other devices and linked sign-ins.
account.signOutDevice.note.text: Sudah selesai bermain di ponsel atau browser ini? Keluarkan saja. Akun online-mu tetap ada untuk perangkat lain dan cara masuk yang tertaut.

account.signOutDevice.body.en: Online play turns off here and this device forgets its key to your online account. The village on this device stays. To play the account here again, sign in with a linked Apple, Google or Game Center account.
account.signOutDevice.body.text: Bermain online dimatikan di sini dan perangkat ini melupakan kuncinya ke akun online-mu. Desa di perangkat ini tetap ada. Untuk memainkan akun ini di sini lagi, masuk dengan akun Apple, Google, atau Game Center yang tertaut.

account.signOutDevice.done.en: This device is signed out. Online play is off here.
account.signOutDevice.done.text: Perangkat ini sudah keluar. Bermain online mati di sini.

account.signOutDevice.lastKey.en: Not signed out: this device holds the only key to your online account. Link Apple, Google or Game Center first, or delete the account instead.
account.signOutDevice.lastKey.text: Belum keluar: perangkat ini menyimpan satu-satunya kunci ke akun online-mu. Tautkan Apple, Google, atau Game Center dulu, atau hapus akunnya saja.

news.reason.resources.en: There were not enough resources in your village on the server.
news.reason.resources.text: Sumber daya di desamu di server tidak cukup.

news.reason.builder.text: Tidak ada Perajin Desa yang senggang.

news.reason.maxLevel.en: It was already at its highest level.

news.reason.gone.en: It was no longer in your village.

news.reason.busy.en: It was already being worked on.

news.reason.limit.en: The limit for it was already reached.

news.reason.changed.en: Your village had already changed, for example on another device.
news.reason.changed.text: Desamu sudah berubah, misalnya di perangkat lain.

refusal.storageFullRefund.en: Storage is too full: cancelling now would lose {lost} of the {refund} you would get back. Make room first.
refusal.storageFullRefund.text: Gudang terlalu penuh: membatalkan sekarang akan menghilangkan {lost} dari {refund} yang dikembalikan. Kosongkan tempat dulu.

league.boardOnline.en: The leaderboards are part of online play.
league.boardOnline.text: Papan peringkat adalah bagian dari permainan online.

sheet.raidRule.en: Raiders can take {pct} of what your storages hold, never more than {cap} of each resource while your Keep is level {level}, and {collectors} of what your collectors have not collected yet.
sheet.raidRule.text: Penyerbu bisa mengambil {pct} dari isi gudangmu, tidak pernah lebih dari {cap} per sumber daya selama Benteng-mu level {level}, dan {collectors} dari hasil pengumpul yang belum kamu kumpulkan.

sheet.collectorPause.en: It produces nothing while it upgrades ({time}). What it holds now stays and can still be collected.
sheet.collectorPause.text: Bangunan ini tidak menghasilkan apa pun selama ditingkatkan ({time}). Isinya sekarang tetap ada dan masih bisa dikumpulkan.

unlock.title.en: {n, plural, one {New warrior unlocked!} other {New warriors unlocked!}}

tutorial.end.daily.en: Your first daily chest is ready: Finish opens it.
tutorial.end.daily.text: Peti harian pertamamu sudah siap: Selesai akan membukanya.

panel.loadFailed.en: This could not open. Check your connection and try again.
panel.loadFailed.text: Ini tidak bisa dibuka. Periksa koneksimu dan coba lagi.

panel.staleChunk.en: A newer version of Kagemura is out. Reload to open this.
panel.staleChunk.text: Versi Kagemura yang lebih baru sudah tersedia. Muat ulang untuk membuka ini.

quality.slowBattles.en: This phone drew battles slowly, so Kagemura will use lighter graphics from the next start. You can change it in Settings → Graphics.
quality.slowBattles.text: Ponsel ini menggambar pertempuran dengan lambat, jadi Kagemura akan memakai grafis yang lebih ringan mulai berikutnya dibuka. Kamu bisa mengubahnya di Pengaturan → Grafis.

events.calendar.server.en: Schedule sent by the game's server. Every countdown is real.
events.calendar.server.text: Jadwal dikirim oleh server game. Setiap hitung mundur itu nyata.

events.calendar.builtIn.en: Built-in schedule. Every countdown is real.
events.calendar.builtIn.text: Jadwal bawaan. Setiap hitung mundur itu nyata.

growth.invite.rule.en: When a friend who started with your friend code reaches Keep {keep} with their village on the server, you each get a fixed reward. Nothing random and nothing to buy.
growth.invite.rule.text: Saat teman yang mulai dengan kode temanmu mencapai Benteng {keep} dengan desanya di server, kalian masing-masing mendapat hadiah tetap. Tidak ada yang acak dan tidak ada yang perlu dibeli.

growth.invite.reward.en: Reward for each of you: {jade} Jade

growth.invite.cap.en: {cap, plural, one {Rewards for up to # friend a month.} other {Rewards for up to # friends a month.}}
growth.invite.cap.text: {cap, plural, other {Hadiah untuk paling banyak # teman per bulan.}}

growth.invite.counts.en: Friends who joined with your code: waiting {waiting}, ready {ready}, rewarded {rewarded}
growth.invite.counts.text: Teman yang bergabung dengan kodemu: menunggu {waiting}, siap {ready}, sudah dapat hadiah {rewarded}

growth.invite.mine.waiting.en: You joined with a friend's code. Reach Keep {keep} with your village on the server and you both get the reward.
growth.invite.mine.waiting.text: Kamu mulai dengan kode teman. Capai Benteng {keep} dengan desamu di server, lalu kalian berdua mendapat hadiahnya.

growth.invite.mine.ready.en: You joined with a friend's code and reached Keep {keep}: your reward is ready.
growth.invite.mine.ready.text: Kamu mulai dengan kode teman dan sudah mencapai Benteng {keep}: hadiahmu siap.

growth.invite.mine.rewarded.en: You joined with a friend's code and collected your reward.
growth.invite.mine.rewarded.text: Kamu mulai dengan kode teman dan sudah mengambil hadiahmu.

growth.invite.needsServer.en: Rewards go to a village on the server. Move your village there in Settings → Online play.
growth.invite.needsServer.text: Hadiah masuk ke desa di server. Pindahkan desamu ke sana di Pengaturan → Bermain online.

growth.invite.enterHint.en: {days, plural, one {Enter their friend code within # day of starting online play.} other {Enter their friend code within # days of starting online play.}}
growth.invite.enterHint.text: {days, plural, other {Masukkan kode temannya dalam # hari sejak mulai bermain online.}}

growth.share.explain.en: {days, plural, one {The server checks this replay and keeps it for # day under a code. Anyone with the link can watch it. The base is shown without its name and your opponent is never named.} other {The server checks this replay and keeps it for # days under a code. Anyone with the link can watch it. The base is shown without its name and your opponent is never named.}}
growth.share.explain.text: Server memeriksa tayangan ulang ini dan menyimpannya selama {days, plural, other {# hari}} dengan sebuah kode. Siapa pun yang punya tautannya bisa menonton. Markas ditampilkan tanpa nama dan lawanmu tidak pernah disebut namanya.

growth.share.minor.en: Your name is not shown on replays shared by players under 18.
growth.share.minor.text: Tayangan ulang yang dibagikan pemain di bawah 18 tahun tidak menampilkan nama.

growth.viewer.generated.en: Against a generated base (made by the computer).

growth.viewer.failed.en: This shared replay could not be opened.
growth.viewer.failed.text: Tayangan ulang yang dibagikan ini tidak bisa dibuka.

growth.viewer.older.en: This replay was recorded under other battle rules, so this version of the game cannot show it.
growth.viewer.older.text: Tayangan ulang ini direkam dengan aturan pertempuran lain, jadi versi game ini tidak bisa menampilkannya.

alliance.banner.note.en: Banners only change how the Alliance looks: no advantage in battle or resources.
alliance.banner.note.text: Panji hanya mengubah tampilan Aliansi: tidak ada keuntungan dalam pertempuran atau sumber daya.

stats.tzNote.en: It also sends your time zone's offset from UTC, so days are counted on your own calendar.
stats.tzNote.text: Fitur ini juga mengirim selisih zona waktumu dari UTC, agar hari dihitung sesuai kalendermu sendiri.

preview.notLive.en: Preview: this is not in the live game yet.
preview.notLive.text: Pratinjau: ini belum ada di game.

heroPick.intro.en: Choose the hero who joins your attacks.
heroPick.intro.text: Pilih pahlawan yang ikut dalam seranganmu.

heroPick.none.en: No hero can join yet. Heroes join from higher Keep levels.
heroPick.none.text: Belum ada pahlawan yang bisa ikut. Pahlawan bergabung di level Benteng yang lebih tinggi.

mastery.none.en: Attack with your warriors to earn mastery.
mastery.none.text: Serang dengan prajuritmu untuk mendapatkan penguasaan.

chat.presetOnly.text: Hanya frasa siap pakai yang ditampilkan.

terms.body.en: The terms of service for Kagemura came into force on {date}. Please read them and accept them to play online. Your village keeps working on this device either way.
terms.body.text: Ketentuan layanan Kagemura berlaku sejak {date}. Baca dan setujui ketentuan ini untuk bermain online. Desamu tetap berjalan di perangkat ini apa pun pilihanmu.

consent.apple.label.en: Help Apple decide refund requests (off until you turn it on)
consent.apple.label.text: Bantu Apple memutuskan permintaan refund (mati sampai kamu menyalakannya)

consent.apple.detail.en: When you ask Apple for a refund, Apple may ask us about the purchase. With this on, we tell Apple that it was delivered and give ranges for how old your account is and how much you have bought and been refunded. Never your name, village or chat. We never ask Apple to refuse a refund.
consent.apple.detail.text: Saat kamu meminta refund ke Apple, Apple bisa bertanya kepada kami tentang pembelian itu. Jika ini menyala, kami memberi tahu Apple bahwa pembelian sudah diterima dan memberikan rentang usia akunmu serta total pembelian dan refund-mu. Tidak pernah namamu, desamu, atau obrolanmu. Kami tidak pernah meminta Apple menolak refund.

significantUpdate.description.en: This update changes how Kagemura works. A parent or guardian can review it before it is used.
significantUpdate.description.text: Pembaruan ini mengubah cara kerja Kagemura. Orang tua atau wali bisa meninjaunya sebelum digunakan.
